entries.title: Player: ""I'm all clear on your offer. Let's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm all clear on your offer. Let's talk about how we deal with the votes."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""As soon as you give the greenlight..."
entries.dialogueText: "As soon as you give the greenlight, I will suspend the people from our party who have ties to the liberation movement."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""I am ready to give you the names o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am ready to give you the names of all of them when the time comes. If this achieves progress for Bludish rights, I am willing to go to the end."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""Progress is progress. I think this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Progress is progress. I think this would open so many doors for our people. And I don't hold the belief that the way forward is armed resistance."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""Well, their claims go to ridiculou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, their claims go to ridiculous lengths. It's true that some of the founders had previous connections to the liberation movement, but most have abandoned it entirely."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So the party was always connected..."
entries.dialogueText: "So the party was always connected to the BFF, as the Sollists and the nationalists claim?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But why now?""
entries.dialogueText: "But why now?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you really believe the changes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you really believe the changes to Article 6 and 7 will go over that well with the Bludish community?"

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""The support for the Workers' Party..."
entries.dialogueText: "The support for the Workers' Party is increasing more than ever. I firmly believe that we will make it to the Assembly in the next elections."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""If we're to finally take place in..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we're to finally take place in the democratic process, I believe we must completely sever our ties with the liberation movement."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""Our movement is now far larger tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our movement is now far larger than theirs, and we have to take this opportunity for the Workers' Party and for Bludish rights."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""That's on your security forces, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's on your security forces, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""But I'm very certain that the rece..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I'm very certain that the recent intel I received about their location is reliable. Among the leadership, the highest profile name is Awlan -- Dewlen Arge's brother."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""What you do with that information..."
entries.dialogueText: "What you do with that information is up to you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Dewlen is already in Antel Rock. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dewlen is already in Antel Rock. If we can get both brothers locked up, the BFF would be crippled."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you know who their current lead..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you know who their current leader is?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What else do you know about the BF..."
entries.dialogueText: "What else do you know about the BFF?"

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""Since the arrest of Dewlen Arge, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since the arrest of Dewlen Arge, I don't believe they have a single leadership position."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""But his brother is the most respec..."
entries.dialogueText: "But his brother is the most respected high-ranking member inside."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What can you tell me about him?""
entries.dialogueText: "What can you tell me about him?"

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""According to my sources, a group o..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to my sources, a group of four commanders are leading the movement in Sordland. Awlan Arge is among them."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""I've learned that Awlan has been t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've learned that Awlan has been to Rumburg several times to meet with the Rumburgian Intelligence Directorate."

entries.dialogueText: "These are massive, Mr. Ejall. I want you to give all of this intelligence to my team as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This entire offer sounds too good..."
entries.dialogueText: "This entire offer sounds too good to be true. I'm not sure if I'm willing to trust you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I hope that's not true.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope that's not true."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""I don't.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""I intend to give leadership back t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I intend to give leadership back to Mansoun. The party still respects him immensely."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""And his name hasn't been stained l..."
entries.dialogueText: "And his name hasn't been stained like most of ours. The government did not label him as a 'former terrorist', and neither was he declared a target by far-right nationalists. Yet."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""As much as I feel like I'm not rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as I feel like I'm not ready for that responsibility, I'm ready to do whatever it takes to grow the Bludish democratic movement. I'm ready to be the new target."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""This way, we can start anew.""
entries.dialogueText: "This way, we can start anew."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I believe that according to their..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe that according to their plan, that part is all on us, sir."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""We'll give you the BFF and you'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll give you the BFF and you'll get us the votes from the USP, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Just imagining talking to Gloria a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just imagining talking to Gloria and Albin about the proposal again is giving me a headache."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What about the Supreme Court?""
entries.dialogueText: "What about the Supreme Court?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I may convince the leaders of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may convince the leaders of the party, but we may want to reach out directly to all 130 of our members."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Focus on the leadership and get yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Focus on the leadership and get your vice president to convince the MPs."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""He has a way with words. I think h..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has a way with words. I think he can sell this idea even to the staunchest conservatives."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I'm sure you can handle it, Mr. Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you can handle it, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""What about it? You're already goin..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about it? You're already going directly against the Old Guard."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Don't you already have a plan to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you already have a plan to get your current reforms through the Court? What does it really change for you?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""With all due respect, Mr. Leke, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Mr. Leke, we are not children here. You know how risky this is. If we lose this, our entire reform package goes down the drain. Not just Article 6 and 7."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The addition of these reforms woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "The addition of these reforms would flip our plan upside down. The implications are not the same at all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Really? Does Petr really have such..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? Does Petr really have such an influence in the Assembly?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Of course, Mr. President. He has a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Mr. President. He has a dialogue with everyone. He's able to reach all corners of the political spectrum."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm sure Mr. Vectern would be help..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure Mr. Vectern would be helpful in getting votes, but I don't see how that would be enough. Besides, the Supreme Court is the main problem."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed and sat down again."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed and sat down again.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Then I'm sorry. I'm not willing to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I'm sorry. I'm not willing to support your proposal."

entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""Ah, yes. We never would have expec..."

entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""It's great that we think alike on..."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""I've heard about that. We ask that..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Thank you for following up on this..."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""I thought you were different, Mr...."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""Then do your absolute best and mak..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then do your absolute best and make sure it doesn't fail."

entries.speaker: Fetih Ejall
entries.title: Fetih Ejall: ""We're not going to *negotiate* our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're not going to *negotiate* our rights here. Either you will fight for us and we will give you what I said in return, or you abandon the Bludish democratic movement."
